run_data_ingestion_workflow: run the full data ingestion workflow that imports photos, enriches location and image data, and exports results
run_generic_import_orchestrator: run the GenericImportOrchestrator to start importing new photo data when ingest_new_data env var is True
run_location_enrichment: run the LocationEnricher to enrich photo entities with geolocation data incrementally or in full
run_image_enrichment: run the ImageEnricher to enrich photo entities with image deduplication and other image features
run_photo_export: run the PhotoExporter to create export entities and optionally dump enriched data to a JSON file
